mechanism: Unmodified loop: dev-aware lexicographic selection with dev-regression rejection.
Candidate proposal disabled (generator never called); isolates the contribution of mutation.
Dev-blind greedy selection: candidates ranked by train accuracy (and version) only. Dev is still measured but cannot influence the pick. This is a weaker selection rule, not the absence of selection.
Dev-regression rejection disabled: the best candidate by (train, dev, version) is accepted even when dev regresses. Selection is otherwise unchanged.
Score-free selection: one candidate per generation is chosen by a seed-controlled RNG and accepted unconditionally; no train or dev score participates in the choice.
